classification: frozen search and evaluation protocol; declared assumptions, not measured limits, and no clinical or survival claim

objective.primary: maximize the sustained-interval margin against the declared pressure screen, then minimize auxiliary capacity and energy among candidates that satisfy it
objective.aggregation: a candidate is reported on its worst declared scenario, not its mean
objective.censoring: a run with no violation through the horizon is reported as "no modeled violation observed through H", never as indefinite support
forbidden: choosing scenario factors to lower the requirement
crediting reduced consumption after unmet demand as efficiency
relabelling the screen to obtain a pass

coronary_conductance.provenance: M7 global factor bounds; anatomical/design hypothesis

left_scale.provenance: BiologicalParameters validator; capacity proxy, not anatomical mass

preservation_conductance.provenance: M7 global factor bounds; vascular allocation control

right_scale.provenance: BiologicalParameters validator; capacity proxy, not anatomical mass

extraction_limit.provenance: M7 global factor bounds; leading deficit effect

glycogen_mmol_L_liver.provenance: M1 inventory range around the 229 reference

liver_function_fraction.provenance: M5/M7 runs used 0.5; export capability is uncertain

mass_coupling.provenance: declared uncertainty on specific myocardial mass per cavity scale

preservation_fraction.provenance: M7 global sampled range; speculative suppressed state

release_cap_mmol_min.provenance: M1 release knob around the 0.21 reference

couplings.mass_ratio: cavity_scale * mass_coupling; charged in auxiliary oxygen demand
couplings.coronary_capacity: auxiliary coronary resistance already divides by cavity scale in BiologicalPumpModel.flows; coronary_conductance multiplies it

registry.interpretation: search assumptions and declared scenarios; not measured limits

no_support.meaning: native pumping loss with no auxiliary release

support_no_suppression.meaning: auxiliary support with organ demand left at baseline

support_with_suppression.meaning: auxiliary support with the declared suppressed-demand scenario

oracle_activation.meaning: prescribed release at the activation-timing latency; an upper reference

delayed_activation.note: the observed policy released at 2.6 s in the reference run

partial_recovery.meaning: native restart with regional reopening and handover

shared_failure.meaning: sensing loss during support; command is latched

constraints.pressure: joint mean/maximum/minimum AO screen over complete 1 s windows
constraints.oxygen_active: no sustained unmet demand beyond numerical tolerance in the active group
constraints.oxygen_preservation: same screen on the preserved group
constraints.auxiliary_self_supply: same screen on the pump group; the auxiliary heart must supply its own myocardium
constraints.model_domain: positive cavity volumes and nonnegative vascular margins throughout
constraints.inventory: total blood volume conserved to the declared tolerance
unassessed: recovery-linked oxygen-deficit thresholds for every tissue
respiratory drive, airway, ventilation-demand coupling and CO2 clearance
tissue oxygen accessibility and microvascular exchange
blood compatibility, endothelial injury and reperfusion injury
biological auxiliary self-demand calibration where applicable

endpoints: chamber work and positive transmural work
auxiliary oxygen demand and unmet ledger
cavity scale as a capacity proxy

numerical.failed_run_policy: a domain exit or failed paired check is recorded with its cause and excluded from optimality claims; it is never counted as a pass, and never silently resampled
numerical.tolerance_policy: tolerances are frozen here; they are not loosened to afford more evaluations, which was tried and rejected in the M7 pilot

search.baseline: matched-budget space-filling sample; required, not optional, since a search without it cannot be shown to beat sampling
search.polish_reason: objective is discontinuous at domain exits and screen boundaries
search.claim: best found within the tested bounds and budget; not a global optimum

stage1.what: pressure feasibility search on the hydraulic stage

stage2.what: coupled evaluation of pressure-passing candidates across scenarios

budget.justification: staging is sound only because the pipeline is one-way; if supply-limited contraction is ever implemented the stages must be merged again

inherited_limitations: L-M4-F01 no tissue glucose buffer; substrate use is instantaneous
prescribed BIO contraction: unmet demand never reduces pumping
supply-limited contraction and full tissue buffering unimplemented
regional pressure minima, CO2/pH, injury, reperfusion and thrombosis unassessed
cavity scale is a capacity proxy, not a determined anatomical mass
amendment_policy: bump version, record what changed and why, and rerun every analysis that depended on the previous version
